name: citation-audit
description: Audits the dataset citations on an open data portal's tool results with interceptors and shows them above the prompt

server.title: Portal MCP server
server.description: The portal server's name in /mcp. Its `statistics` tool is the one audited

mode.title: Audit mode
mode.description: audit: report only. strip: remove citations that fail a check, except a license check. block: refuse a result when the URL, quote, or license check fails, and strip citations that fail only the binding check

demoDir.title: citation-audit-demo checkout
demoDir.description: Your clone of citation-audit-demo, which holds src/audit-cli.ts. Leave empty to use the folder Claude Code was started in
